summary: Refuse plain output for nested market tags/trend reports and distinguish invalid or missing explicit snapshot IDs from the default latest-complete selection.
reason: DEV-931 and DEV-932 affect hand-written Etsy market commands rather than generator-owned printers or MCP code. Preserve nested-output format guards, typed not-found handling including absent stores, and explicit positive-ID validation across demand/tags/shops/price/gaps and paired trend selectors. Omitted IDs retain successful no-data notes and latest-complete selection; flag metadata must not advertise an invalid zero default to MCP or help consumers. Preserve literal cmd.Flags().Int64Var declarations for snapshot at all five command sites and from/to in trend so verify-skill can discover them; each calls mktHideZeroDefault, which clears DefValue and wraps the registered pflag.Value with mktPositiveIDValue to suppress zero help defaults without losing numeric MCP schemas or pflag parsing. Synthetic CLI and companion-CLI MCP seam tests protect these contracts, including selection of an older explicit snapshot.
markers: cmd.Flags().Int64Var(&flagFrom, "from", 0, "Positive snapshot ID; omit both for the latest two complete snapshots")
cmd.Flags().Int64Var(&flagTo, "to", 0, "Positive snapshot ID; omit both for the latest two complete snapshots")
